overlays.body: Engineering rigor paired with fluid interaction.

projects.title: Apex Financial Platform
projects.summary: Complete real-time financial trading web application with WebSocket order books, interactive WebGL market depth, and portfolio risk management.

caseStudy.problem: Financial analysts needed instant order-book visual feedback without UI thread locks during heavy trading volatility.
caseStudy.solution: Engineered offscreen canvas worker rendering paired with binary WebSocket streaming buffers.
caseStudy.outcome: Achieved 60fps frame rates under 100k events/sec with zero jank.

projects.title: Neural Canvas Studio
projects.summary: Collaborative AI visual canvas SaaS platform supporting multi-user real-time sync, generative node graphs, and production pipelines.

caseStudy.problem: Creative agencies struggled to coordinate AI generation workflows across distributed teams.
caseStudy.solution: Built CRDT-based synchronized state layer with optimistic mutation rollbacks.
caseStudy.outcome: Adopted by 40+ studios in private beta with >99.9% sync consistency.

projects.title: Pulse Ops Portal
projects.summary: Full-scale cloud observability website providing distributed microservice topology inspection, live telemetry streams, and incident diagnosis.

caseStudy.problem: Identifying cascaded microservice latencies required cross-referencing dozens of dashboards.
caseStudy.solution: Unified telemetry streams into an interactive directed graph with live threshold highlighting.

projects.title: Vanguard Atelier
projects.summary: Flagship luxury direct-to-consumer e-commerce website featuring dynamic product customization, fluid page transitions, and frictionless checkout.

experience.summary: Leading core product web engineering, building interactive client dashboards, and driving 95+ Lighthouse scores.
Delivered award-winning interactive websites, scroll-driven visual narratives, and design systems for enterprise brands.
